en_title: Agent Coulson Actor Teases Link to Just-Announced Marvel TV Show, Zodiac
subtitle: 神盾局的线索
opus_summary: 科尔森演员转发漫威新剧《Zodiac》公告，引发该剧与《神盾局特工》有关联的猜测。新剧是间谍惊悚剧，计划2028年推出，标志含神盾局元素，几周后开始选角。

paragraphs.en: Agents of SHIELD star Clark Gregg, most famous for playing Agent Phil Coulson in the first Avengers movie, has teased his involvement with the just-announced Marvel TV show, Zodiac.
paragraphs.cn: 《神盾局特工》主演Clark Gregg暗示，自己可能参与漫威刚刚公布的新剧《Zodiac》。他最为人熟知的角色，是在首部《复仇者联盟》电影中饰演的菲尔·科尔森特工。

paragraphs.en: Marvel announced Zodiac at a New York Comic Con panel yesterday with a logo, below, a 2028 release window, and little else. We know it's a spy thriller and, based on the logo, it has something to do with SHIELD. Hot on the heels of the reveal, Gregg shared the announcement to his Instagram , sparking speculation that the two shows are linked.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威昨天在纽约漫展的一场座谈会上公布了《Zodiac》，展示了下方的剧集标志，并宣布该剧将于2028年推出，除此之外几乎没有透露更多信息。目前已知这是一部间谍惊悚剧，从标志来看，它与神盾局有关。消息公布后不久，Gregg就在Instagram上转发了公告，引发了两部剧存在关联的猜测。

paragraphs.en: The logo for the show features the show’s title, Zodiac, with a stylized “o” and a stylized “a.” The “a” has a little eagle head in the middle, mirroring the SHIELD logo.
paragraphs.cn: 剧集标志以剧名《Zodiac》为主体，其中字母「o」和「a」经过了特殊设计。「a」的中间有一个小鹰头，与神盾局标志相呼应。

paragraphs.en: "For anyone who knows the comics, if you look closely at this title design, you’ll see a few clues about where we’re going," Marvel TV head Brad Winderbaum told the audience during the announcement. "I can’t tell you anything else about it yet because it’s a secret. We're going to start casting it in a couple weeks.”
paragraphs.cn: 漫威电视部门负责人Brad Winderbaum在公布新剧时对现场观众说：「熟悉漫画的朋友，如果仔细看这个剧名的设计，就能找到一些关于我们接下来会往哪个方向走的线索。我暂时还不能透露其他信息，因为这是个秘密。我们会在几周后开始选角。」

paragraphs.en: Agents of SHIELD ended back in 2020 and saw Gregg’s Agent Coulson return from beyond the grave in android form. However, the series is not listed on the Disney+ "MCU Complete Timeline" section, which features every single canon MCU movie, TV series, and one-off special, so its place in official Marvel canon is unclear.
paragraphs.cn: 《神盾局特工》早在2020年就已完结，Gregg饰演的科尔森特工在剧中以仿生人的形态死而复生。不过，Disney+的「MCU完整时间线」栏目并未收录该剧。这个栏目囊括了所有属于漫威电影宇宙正史的电影、剧集和单部特别节目，因此《神盾局特工》在漫威官方正史中的地位仍不明确。

paragraphs.en: Chloe Bennet, who played Daisy, recently said she's "still low-key angry" that Agents of SHIELD isn't considered fully part of MCU canon — though has insisted she would reprise her role if asked. Fans are hoping to see the return of Samuel L. Jackson’s Nick Fury in Zodiac, which is named after a criminal organization made up of bad guys named after zodiac signs. Nick Fury’s brother, Scorpio, is one of them.
paragraphs.cn: 饰演黛西的Chloe Bennet最近表示，《神盾局特工》没有被完全纳入漫威电影宇宙正史，让她「心里还是有点生气」，不过她也明确表示，只要收到邀请，就愿意再次出演这个角色。粉丝们希望能在《Zodiac》中看到塞缪尔·杰克逊饰演的尼克·弗瑞回归。剧名取自一个犯罪组织，组织成员都是以黄道十二星座命名的反派，尼克·弗瑞的兄弟天蝎座（Scorpio）就是其中之一。

paragraphs.en: Of course, there’s been no official word on where Zodiac will go. All we know is that it’s a spy thriller, and if it goes in another direction to the comics, it wouldn’t be the first time for the MCU.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，官方尚未透露《Zodiac》的剧情走向。我们只知道它是一部间谍惊悚剧，即便它走上了与漫画不同的路线，对漫威电影宇宙来说也不是头一回。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere in Marvel TV shows, Daredevil: Born Again will end with Season 3 . Ahead of that wrapping up, VisionQuest is landing on Disney+ on October 14, and the showrunners said they didn’t pay much attention to the wider MCU when putting the story together.
paragraphs.cn: 至于其他漫威剧集，《夜魔侠：重生》将在第3季完结。在该剧收官之前，《VisionQuest》将于10月14日登陆Disney+。该剧主创表示，他们在构思故事时，并没有太多顾及漫威电影宇宙的其他部分。

paragraphs.en: VisionQuest sees Paul Bettany reprise his role as Vision on the run from people seeking to weaponize him. The limited series will be eight episodes long. In case you missed it, here's everything announced at the Marvel TV and Animation panel at NYCC 2026 .
paragraphs.cn: 在《VisionQuest》中，保罗·贝坦尼将再次饰演幻视，躲避那些试图把他变成武器的人。这部限定剧共8集。
